explanation: The script was written so that any crew role could be played by a man or a woman. Weaver went on to play Ripley in three sequels.

claims.text: Sigourney Weaver played Ellen Ripley in Alien (1979).
Jamie Lee Curtis, Linda Hamilton and Meryl Streep did not play Ellen Ripley.
The Alien script was written so that any of its crew roles could be played by a man or a woman.
Weaver played Ripley in three sequels: Aliens, Alien 3 and Alien Resurrection.
